# `second`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
second(expr)
```

Returns the second component of the given expression.

If `expr` is a TIMESTAMP or a string that can be cast to timestamp,
it returns the second of that timestamp.
If `expr` is a TIME type (since 4.1.0), it returns the second of the time-of-day.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | > 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- second, example 1
> SELECT second('2018-02-14 12:58:59');
59
```

```sql
-- second, example 2
> SELECT second(TIME'13:25:59.999999');
59
```
